策略仅做多或空仓。信号在后续成交上按限价和成交量撮合；未成交部分在下一次决策前撤: Long or flat positions only. Signals match later trades using limit prices and available volume. Unfilled orders are cancelled before the next decision. Remaining positions are valued at the last price, without forced liquidation.

动量只使用过去价格，留出段可使用此前历史预热。未来标签不进入因子，跨分界标签剔除: Momentum uses past prices, including earlier history for holdout warmup. Future labels never enter the factor; boundary-crossing labels are excluded. Fix parameters before examining the holdout; repeated tuning against it does not establish out-of-sample validity.
